text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Hoo boy, I'm lookin' forward to this! The Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: And this time, there's gonna be a Mejiro family showdown, right?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: That's right! I hope you brought a fan, 'cause this race is gonna get heated!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: They're quite excited… I can hear them all the way from here.
choice_data_list: That's because it's a Triple Crown race.
That's because it's a Triple Crown race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Indeed. An opportunity coveted by any and all Umamusume…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Beyond that, for me, it is a chance to truly compete against Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: It's strange. Long before this, the two of us would race against each other, but there were no spectators back then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Now, all eyes are on us…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I'm sure everyone in the Mejiro family is watching us as well.
choice_data_list: You'll have to run with dignity, then!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Even if my opponent is Ryan—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: No. Especially because my opponent is Ryan, someone whom I respect, I must gain a victory most magnificent!
